hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains in the ICU at Hospital DF Star following emergency admission for severe abdominal obstruction. Son Carlos Bolsonaro reported a deteriorating state, while Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized restricted daily family visits under strict conditions, including a ban on mobile phones.
hotspots.affect: Commands intense affective investment driven by acute health panic among supporters and hyper-polarized legal friction over judicial visit restrictions.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: French judicial authorities raided Rassemblement National headquarters and the Interior Ministry amid allegations that Prefect Hugues Moutouh leaked confidential police and judicial intelligence to Marine Le Pen’s party. The expanding probe has sparked intense public controversy over the party's influence within senior state institutions.
hotspots.affect: Drives maximum outrage and institutional alarm centered on state apparatus security, judicial independence, and political corruption scandals.

hotspots.title: Milei Triumphs as Tesla Launches in Argentina
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei headlined the official launch of Tesla in Argentina alongside Elon Musk, receiving a custom stainless-steel Cybertruck emblazoned with his signature lion graphic. Milei seized the event to champion state deregulation, declaring that removing government obstacles was key to attracting international capital.
hotspots.affect: Generates strong affective triumph and ideological validation among libertarian and right-wing populist movements globally.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Spain's Vox party and leader Santiago Abascal intensified campaign efforts ahead of the November 29 elections, staging major rallies in Andalusia and advocating aggressive anti-immigration and remigration policies. Campaign events have been marked by fierce partisan polemics and physical confrontations, including an assault on a Vox parliamentary candidate in Galicia.
hotspots.affect: Fosters high emotional investment around national sovereignty, anti-immigrant polarization, and election campaign combativeness.

hotspots.title: AfD Pushes Early Premier Vote in Saxony-Anhalt
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) has triggered political controversy in Saxony-Anhalt by advancing a motion for an early vote on the state premier, while securing controversial seats on the parliamentary intelligence oversight committee. Concurrently, Björn Höcke was overwhelmingly re-elected leader of AfD Thuringia, demanding an absolute majority to form a single-party government.
hotspots.affect: Evokes heightened alarm and political heat regarding far-right parliamentary dominance and state intelligence oversight.
